parameters.toolDescription: What the customer saved for later, newest first: products and service listings (businesses such as plumbers or printers) in one list. Each entry has kind "product" or "listing". USE IT WHEN: They ask what they saved, or want to buy something saved earlier. To show them, pass the productIds to Show-Products and the listingIds to listings_display. NOT THIS TOOL: Not as a way to browse the catalogue. ⚠ product or listing null means it is no longer available — say 'no longer available' and offer to remove it; never skip the row or say why.
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ identity: { channel: $('Inbound').first().json.channel, externalId: $('Inbound').first().json.externalId, displayName: $('Inbound').first().json.displayName, handle: $('Inbound').first().json.handle, language: $('Inbound').first().json.language }, kind: $fromAI("kind", "Only one kind. Leave it out for both. One of: product, listing.", "string") || undefined }) }}

parameters.toolDescription: Adds a product or a service listing to the customer's saved list. Send exactly one of productId and listingId. Saving a listing reveals no contact, costs nothing and tells the business nothing. USE IT WHEN: They like something but are not buying it now, or want to keep a business to contact later. NOT THIS TOOL: Not instead of the basket when they said they want to buy it.
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ identity: { channel: $('Inbound').first().json.channel, externalId: $('Inbound').first().json.externalId, displayName: $('Inbound').first().json.displayName, handle: $('Inbound').first().json.handle, language: $('Inbound').first().json.language }, productId: $fromAI("productId", "The 24-character product id to save, from catalog_get_product or a product search result. Not with listingId.", "string") || undefined, listingId: $fromAI("listingId", "The 24-character listing id to save, from a search result with kind \"listing\" or listings_get. Not with productId.", "string") || undefined }) }}

parameters.toolDescription: Takes a product or a service listing off the customer's saved list. USE IT WHEN: They are no longer interested, or clear an unavailable entry. NOT THIS TOOL: Not just because they added it to the basket — they did not ask.
parameters.url: ={{ $env.JOVI_MALL_BASE_URL }}/api/internal/bot/wishlist/{{ encodeURIComponent(String($fromAI("itemId", "The 24-character id to drop: productId for a product, listingId for a listing, from wishlist_list.", "string")).trim()).replace(/^\.*$/, "_") }}
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ identity: { channel: $('Inbound').first().json.channel, externalId: $('Inbound').first().json.externalId, displayName: $('Inbound').first().json.displayName, handle: $('Inbound').first().json.handle, language: $('Inbound').first().json.language } }) }}

parameters.toolDescription: Whether the customer may review a product, a delivery or a service listing, and if not, why. A listing can be reviewed once the customer has unlocked at least one of its contacts. USE IT WHEN: Before offering to take a review, so nobody ineligible is asked for one. NOT THIS TOOL: Not after a failed submission — this is the check that avoids one. ⚠ eligible false is a normal answer, not a failure.
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ identity: { channel: $('Inbound').first().json.channel, externalId: $('Inbound').first().json.externalId, displayName: $('Inbound').first().json.displayName, handle: $('Inbound').first().json.handle, language: $('Inbound').first().json.language }, subjectType: $fromAI("subjectType", "delivery takes a SHIPMENT id, not an order id. listing takes the listing id. One of: product, delivery, listing.", "string"), subjectId: $fromAI("subjectId", "The id of the thing being reviewed: a product id when subjectType is product, a SHIPMENT id when it is delivery — never an order id — and a LISTING id when it is listing.", "string") }) }}

parameters.toolDescription: Reviews the customer wrote, newest first — products, deliveries and service listings, including any an administrator hid. USE IT WHEN: 'What have I reviewed', 'did my review go up', 'why can't I see my review', or to check whether they already rated something. NOT THIS TOOL: Not other people's reviews (catalog_list_product_reviews). ⚠ Whether a review is visible is publiclyVisible, NEVER status — a delivery review shows status published but appears nowhere, it is internal. subjectLabel null: refer to the order instead of reading an id aloud.
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ identity: { channel: $('Inbound').first().json.channel, externalId: $('Inbound').first().json.externalId, displayName: $('Inbound').first().json.displayName, handle: $('Inbound').first().json.handle, language: $('Inbound').first().json.language }, status: $fromAI("status", "Narrow to one state: published, or unpublished (an administrator hid it). Leave empty unless the customer asked for one — the default returns both, which is usually what they mean. One of: published, unpublished.", "string") || undefined }) }}
